landing.tagline: Understand local dish risk and speak up at the table.
landing.positioning: An allergy-aware travel food assistant for Hanoi. Build a private allergy profile, browse local dishes by risk level, and generate bilingual question cards for restaurant staff.
landing.noInstall: No install required — it runs right in your browser.
